lesson_title: Cost and Revenue: Where Profit Peaks
hook_text: Six units still makes R74 profit. And six is still the WRONG answer.
clip_script: March through the table. Unit one: earns R40, costs R20 — make it, R20 to the good. Unit two: R40 against R14 — make it, R26 up. Unit three: R40 against R12 — make it. Unit four: R40 against R18 — make it. Unit five: R40 against R32 — still R8 ahead — make it. Unit six: R40 against R46 — this unit wipes out R6 of profit. Turn it down. Halt at five. The rule — produce until marginal revenue equals marginal cost — delivered the answer without a single profit calculation.
visual_style: A boerewors-roll counter ticking upward as each roll slides across the grill, stamped green 'MAKE IT' or red 'TURN IT DOWN' as its marginal numbers flash.
pacing: Steady roll-by-roll rhythm that snaps to a hard stop on the red stamp at unit six.
